channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Sabotage, fury and dirty protest as villagers rage at destruction of Earl's woodland
item.description: Clearance work at Broome Heath near Bungay has seen villagers take extreme measures to voice their displeasure.

item.title: Norfolk firm donates selection boxes to every child at city school
item.description: Resins 'R' Us, based in Colton, near Barnham Broom, Norfolk, has donated 75 chocolate selection boxes to children at Danby Wood School in Norwich.

item.title: Die Hard IS a Christmas film says new musical parody
item.description: Is Die Hard a Christmas film? A musical parody based on the classic film is returning to Norwich Puppet Theatre in January to settle the debate.

item.title: Building housing popular city centre bar still on the market after two years
item.description: A building home to one the city's most popular nightlife spots is still on the market.

item.title: Family's festive trip to Lapland ends in 'nightmare' journey home
item.description: One Wymondham family spoke of their 'nightmare' journey home from a Norwich to Lapland day trip.

item.title: Woman who had led 'remarkably content life' found dead amid no-fault eviction stress
item.description: A Downham Market woman whose disappearance sparked a major search operation until her body was discovered in a dock had been handed a non-fault eviction notice shortly before she vanished, Norfolk Coroner's Court has heard.

item.title: Norfolk housing bid quashed over fears of putting people 'at risk of harm'
item.description: Ruth Hicks and Rachel Cook had hoped to build six houses off Bradfield Road in Trunch, near North Walsham, Norfolk.

item.title: Hotel on Norfolk coast could gain more rooms under new plans
item.description: A hotel on the Norfolk coast could gain additional rooms under new plans submitted by Barrett Properties to Great Yarmouth Borough Council.

item.title: Site of 640 potential homes could unearth archaeological finds
item.description: According to the Archaeological Service at Suffolk County Council the proposed site of 640 new homes in Halesworth could unearth historical finds.

item.title: Community spirit shines as care home surprised with 'incredible haul' of gifts
item.description: A care home in Lowestoft has been inundated with gifts to help everyone enjoy a magical Christmas.
